newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain implements control over public expenditure.
newsitem.headline: Spain implements control over public expenditure.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet approved a measure on Friday aimed at strengthening public spending controls, government spokesman Migel Angel Rodriguez said.
"The government approved a deal which strengthens expenditure controls. This is a development of the general budget law," Rodriguez told reporters after the cabinet's weekly meeting.
Rodriguez added that new controls would be directed especially to public contracts.
"It's very important ...because we are talking about more than 70 percent of public expenditure," he said.
